component.name: Snatch
component.summary: Download and play videos with yt-dlp

description.p: Snatch is a desktop window for yt-dlp. Paste a link, pick a format and download it, or search and play videos without leaving the app.
On first launch it offers to download the current yt-dlp, which YouTube needs. It keeps that copy in your home folder, and you can go back to your system's yt-dlp at any time.
